about: Strokes for the tests of the pen and of the reading of ink: circles, crosses, lines and scribbles, from a mouse and from a trackpad, drawn fast and slow, at 25%, 100% and 400% zoom. Made by e2e/ink-hands.ts: a model of a hand moved the pointer of the system Chrome in real time, with the Pen in hand on the built app, and what is kept is what the board’s pointer events delivered. The browser, its timing and its coalescing are real; the hand is a model, not a person. Each go has the camera it was drawn under (screen = board units * z + x, y) and its strokes: `at` is every sample as flat x,y pairs in screen pixels from the board’s corner, the press first; `events` is how many samples each pointer move carried; `ms` is how long the stroke took. A circle reads as a circle, a cross as a cross, a line as an underline, a scribble as nothing.
